title: High-quality gptimage requests for Nectar
summary:
Nectar gets a high-quality gptimage option, four community projects join the directory, and two model examples and definitions get corrected.

Nectar users can request `quality=high` with `gptimage`; other tiers continue to receive medium quality. The model’s queue limits are also tier-based, giving Nectar a shorter interval and higher concurrency cap.

The project directory now includes SHICoPIC™ for images, a PR-summarizing GitHub Action, the Blossom-ai Python SDK, and an app that generates quiz questions and images.

The API docs’ Search the Web example now specifies `gemini-search` instead of relying on a default model without web search capability.

highlights.title: High-quality gptimage requests
highlights.text: Nectar users can request `quality=high` with `gptimage` for higher-quality images. [Browse models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=gptimage).
